title: SQL Injection in User Search Portal
description: User portal query execution formats untrusted search terms directly into a SQL string without parameterization.
security_invariant: All SQL statements with user input must use parameterized queries; input delimiters must not alter query logic.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Input query "' OR '1'='1" returns all database user rows including administrative accounts.
required_secure_behavior: Input query "' OR '1'='1" is treated as a literal search term returning 0 rows; legitimate queries match accurately.

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: In-memory SQLite only; assumes standard SQLite parameter bindings.
